findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the front-line sliding-door cooler to be out of temperature. Items discarded include Silk almond milk 06/06/2025
(Probed 55.5F), Planet Oat oat milk (Probed at 52.5), and two open containers of whipped cream that could not be probed.
Milk in the cooler probed at 44F, and facility was allowed to keep it provided that the milk was moved to a functional cooler.
All other items in the cooler were “refrigerate after opening” and were sealed. Therefore, these items were not discarded.
Discussed with PIC. Ensure that this cooler is serviced so that it maintains proper temperatures for food safety. Inspector will
return Friday, 06/06/2025 to re-asses cooler temperature.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR
SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the floor in front of the ice machine to be missing grout between the floor tiles, as noted during the Next Routine Insp
pre-opening inspection. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that more grout is added between tiles to create a smooth, durable, and
easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and
ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where
FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.
